featured_reviews.name: Ajit Bhobe
featured_reviews.review_text:
My HP Laserjet 1020 Plus printer was not working properly. I had not cleaned or serviced it for many years and was looking for a good technician. Since very few technicians repair the HP Laserjet 1020 Plus, I searched on Google and came across Printer Repair Center, Dahisar.

I spoke to Mr. Rajesh in the evening and explained the issue. He asked me to share a photo of my printer and my address. The very next day, he promptly sent a technician, Mr. Ashwin, who did a thorough cleaning and servicing. The service charge was very reasonable—just ₹450—and my printer started working like new again.

I really appreciate Mr. Rajesh’s quick response and professional service. I would definitely recommend Printer Repair Center, Dahisar to anyone looking for reliable printer repair and servicing.
